# isoplane cache

Manage compiled runtimes shared by local sessions.

```bash
isoplane cache <command>
```

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`isoplane cache info`](#isoplane-cache-info) | Show runtime cache usage. |
| [`isoplane cache clean`](#isoplane-cache-clean) | Remove compiled runtimes. |

## isoplane cache info

Show runtime cache usage.

```bash
isoplane cache info
```

## isoplane cache clean

Remove compiled runtimes.

```bash
isoplane cache clean
```
